verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a hosted coding-agent service with cloud chats and tasks, so the axis applies. The pack documents no data-export feature, no open export format and no account-exit path. Resuming or searching local chats, and working in the user's own git repository, are adjacent behaviors and not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
